headline: 1948 educational film warns that *cheap* products are *never* thrifty
quote: Buying cheap unsatisfactory products is never thrifty, so, even though this pen will make him draw money from his savings account, it is a better buy and a necessity.
title: 1948 educational film: Is buying cheap products actually thrifty?
caption: A 1948 film about saving money explains why purchasing low-quality goods can backfire.
comment: Do you prefer buying cheaper items or investing in quality?
